dedupe_keys.name: international dataset on eco innovation parks 168 eco industrial parks 78 attributes

description: This dataset describes 168 European and non-European eco-innovation parks, meaning eco-industrial parks or areas that mix residential and industrial activity, each with 78 attributes. The Zenodo record says the attributes cover general information such as park type and size, 12 eco-criteria (for example waste management, material flow, renewable energy and water management, with sub-criteria), 8 success factors such as financial incentives and research cooperation, and the information sources. It was published in 2018 by Olivier Jacquat, Guillaume Massard and Daniel Zürcher as a desktop research team output, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one Excel file with a metadata worksheet, alongside a survey report on Zenodo. Coverage is international. Caveats: the record warns the data may be incomplete or inaccurate, and it has not been updated since 2018. For simulation it gives park-level symbiosis and shared utility attributes to seed industrial symbiosis and interdependency models. Related catalogue records include the Yangtze chemical industrial parks map and the georeferenced industrial sites excess heat data.
